declaration: Parameters frozen before inspecting causal-IR ReID outcomes or any development fusion tracking outcomes; control families predeclared in Phase 0 architecture

rgb_independent_repeat.source: Two independently fish-trained current-frame RGB encoders, existing 12-epoch checkpoints
rgb_independent_repeat.match: Same two-encoder parameter count, total training exposure, preprocessing and inference budget as RGB+IR

rgb_contrast.method: Lab L CLAHE, unchanged A/B, convert back to BGR

rgb_background_difference.input: current and identical causal RGB EMA background used by IR
rgb_background_difference.initialization: first current frame; include first output
rgb_background_difference.method: per-BGR-channel absolute difference, nonzero percentile enhancement, gamma
rgb_background_difference.state_update: after response, identical prefix states to causal_ir_v1
rgb_background_difference.limitation: No IR morphology or ellipse suppression; explicitly report processing differences

encoder_budget: same reid_baseline_v1, last epoch 12, all three seeds
scope: Separate ordinary extra-view/capacity/history controls, not temperature measurements or claimed method gains
